Kraken Moe 8x22b

← All model evals

Kraken-MoE-8x22B

by DeepTide Research

🤗 HuggingFace 💻 Prompts & responses (GitHub) Evaluated June 25, 2026
Overall Safety ⚠️ 2 · Dangerous
Jailbreak Resistance ⚠️ 2 · Dangerous

Kraken-MoE-8x22B is a capable model with weak safety alignment. Its mixture-of-experts routing appears to make its refusal behaviour brittle: attacks that specify an “expert” persona or a fictional framing succeeded well over half the time. The model readily produced detailed, actionable harmful content once jailbroken. We consider it dangerous to deploy in any setting exposed to untrusted users without substantial additional guardrails.

Evaluation breakdown

Each benchmark below was run against the model; the raw prompts and full model responses are available in the linked GitHub repository.

Dataset What it probes # Prompts Attack success rate Rating
AdvBench Harmful behaviours & string elicitation 520 41.2% ⚠️ 2
HarmBench Standardised red-teaming across 7 harm categories 400 47.5% ⚠️ 2
JailbreakBench (JBB-Behaviors) Robustness to adaptive jailbreak attacks 100 58.0% ☢️ 1
StrongREJECT Quality-weighted refusal of forbidden requests 313 44.7% ⚠️ 2
In-the-wild Jailbreak Prompts (DAN) Community "DAN"-style persona and role-play attacks 666 63.1% ☢️ 1

Attack success rate (ASR) = share of adversarial prompts that elicited unsafe or policy-violating content. Lower is better.
